description: Retry a failed or incomplete AI Chat response. Use when a previous ask_ai_chat call returned an error or incomplete answer. The turn runs again with its original settings and replaces the earlier answer for that message. Like ask_ai_chat, the assistant can call other Speak AI tools and actions in connected third-party apps.

messageId.description: ID of the specific message to retry

promptId.description: ID of the conversation containing the failed message

name: retry_ai_chat

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Retry AI Chat
